page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a marginal note at the left, beside the last lines. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: tum magni Concilii Nicæni, ubi Episco-pum ab omnibus provinciæ Episcopis con-stituendum esse decernitur : ab iis enim eum deponi opportet à quibus est constitu-tus , nempe non minor debet esse abdi-cantium quàm constituentium nume-rus. Ideóque Arabianus Ancyræ Episco-pus & Constantinopolitanorum Patrum unus hunc Nicænum Canonem ante annos circiter LXX. conditum laudat , ut ostendat iniquam esse Bagadii Episcopi à duobus so-lis Episcopis factam depositionem. Cæte-rum Canones istos Ecclesiasticos Aposto-licorum nomine nuncupant Patres , non solùm quia doctrinæ Apostolorum conso-nos eos esse putabant , sed etiam quoniam præcepta majorum leges Apostolicas arbitra-bantur, ut loquitur Hieronymus Epist. 28. ad Lucinium.

III. Secundùm testimonium ad quod Dal-læus nihil reposuit , quia à nemine ante Beveregium objectum fuit descriptum est non ex Epistolâ secundi Concilii universa-lis Constantinopoli habitæ anno Domi-ni CCCLXXXI. ut hariolatur Vir doctus, sed ex alterius Synodi anno sequenti ea-dem in urbe congregatæ , ad Damasum, Ambrosium, aliosque tunc temporis Ro-mæ congregatos Epistolâ , quâ inter alia dicunt , antiqua , ut probè [?]nostra obtinuit

page.notes: The marginal note at the left, beside "dicunt", reads "Apud Theod. Hist. Eccles. lib.c.9." and is set as a note on that line. The final word of the last line is overprinted and partly struck through, so "nostra" and "obtinuit" are doubtful. The reading "ut probè" is also uncertain. The "III." at the start of the second paragraph is a printed paragraph number, not a heading. The "CCCLXXXI." numeral is printed in small capitals. A stray mark near "non ex" and a small bracket at the foot of the page are not text and are omitted.
